name: Multispectral Camera
description: An imaging instrument that samples several visible and near-infrared bands.
tooltip: Useful for mapping land cover and broad environmental change.

name: Thermal Radiometer
description: Measures emitted infrared energy to estimate surface temperature.
tooltip: Thermal measurements can reveal fires, heat islands, and water stress.

name: Fluxgate Magnetometer
description: Measures local magnetic-field strength and direction.
tooltip: A boom-mounted magnetometer helps characterize planetary and space-weather fields.
